content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate prices in the first 10 days of the 30-day horizon.", "Sentiment spikes near the end of the history window correlate with forecast overshoots.", "Model forecasts show mean-reversion bias, especially when true prices dip below 75.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment history includes at least one positive signal.", "Overshoots occur when sentiment is positive and historical prices are trending upward.", "Lagging forecasts are more accurate when the true price moves in the same direction as the model’s early trend.", "Model bias is strongest when sentiment is neutral or negative and prices are declining.", "Forecast calibration should adjust for sentiment-driven volatility in the final 5 days of the 30-day window."]}
